subject: reasoning
question: Atul starts from his home and drives 5 km towards north. He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left, and drives 4 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km and reaches his office. In which direction is the office with respect to his home? (Note: All turns are 90° turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
• Atul starts from his home and drives 5 km towards north.
 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left, and drives 4 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km and reaches his office.
